title: Lina's Da Nang Souvenir

segments: Lina arrived at the bustling Han Market in Da Nang. Bright colors and new smells filled the air. She was excited to find a special souvenir for her family. However, she felt a little nervous. Many vendors spoke only Vietnamese. Lina wondered how she would ask for help to buy a gift. She really wanted to practice her English.

Because of this, Lina decided to investigate a colorful stall. She saw many beautiful crafts. A friendly vendor, Minh, smiled at her. Lina pointed to a small, wooden boat, hoping to ask its price. She used hand gestures, trying to show she wanted to buy it. Minh, however, looked confused and offered her a fruit instead.

Because of this, Lina understood Minh did not know what she wanted. She felt a little shy, but she really wanted the wooden boat. Lina took out her phone. She found a picture of a similar wooden boat. Then, she pointed to the picture and said slowly, 'Boat. I want boat.
